summary: Iteration 17 (frontend only): new Home screen flow. All requested features PASS at 1920x1080: after Clerk ticket sign-in '/' shows home-screen (title 'What should I do next?', home-task-box, workspace-cards), no browser view rendered. Cards show name + status (PAUSED/QUESTION/WORKING/IDLE); hover reveals edit/popout/close (no close on id 1, close present on new ws). workspace-card-new -> dialog -> TEST_HomeWS created, card added, picker auto-selects it; rename via card edit works (prefilled). Picker lists all workspaces; selecting CTO WORKSPACE (waiting_input) switches placeholder to 'Reply to CTO WORKSPACE's question…' and button to 'Reply'. Empty input disables Run. Enter submits -> POST /api/runs?group=<new id>, toast 'Shadow is on it in TEST_HomeWS2', input cleared, card status -> WORKING (OpenAI configured; run completed with summary 'The title of example.com is: Example Domain'). Pause all disabled when nothing running; Resume all -> toast 'Resumed 2 workspace task(s)', statuses -> WORKING. All 10 home-nav icons open home-panel-sheet (380px left sheet) with correct side-panel-title; side-panel-collapse-button and Escape close it. Clicking a card opens full browser view (workspace) for that workspace with side-rail, left-panel, group-bar, command-bar ('Tell Shadow what to do in TEST_HomeWS2'), activity-panel; back-to-home-button returns home. Close workspace from card -> toast, card removed, picker falls back to Main. ?solo=1 skips home (solo-group-name, no back button). Reload '/' -> home. No page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Header row (logo + 10 nav icons + UserButton) does not wrap/scroll; only ~6 icons visible, History/Passwords/Permissions/Laptop icons and the user menu (sign-out) are clipped off-screen and unreachable on phones. Make icon menu horizontally scrollable, collapse into an overflow menu, or wrap.

Card names truncate heavily ('CTO WORKS...', 'TEST_Home...') at 4-column desktop grid because the hidden (opacity-0) edit/popout/close buttons still reserve width. Consider absolute-positioning the hover actions or showing full name on second line / title attr.
Edit/popout/close and 'Watch' are hover-only (opacity-0 group-hover); on touch devices rename/close workspace from home is not discoverable.

integration_issues.issue: When a run completes, the card goes straight from WORKING to IDLE (groups only expose active run), so the user on home never sees 'Done' or the summary unless opening the workspace; and on a fresh session opening that workspace shows activity 'No task yet' because lastRunByGroup is in-memory. Consider showing last run status (Done/Failed) on the card for a while and loading last run per group on open.

action_items: (Medium) Fix mobile header overflow on home: nav icons + user menu are clipped at 390px width
(Low) Avoid name truncation on workspace cards caused by invisible hover buttons reserving space
(Low) Show completed/failed status on card after run ends and load last run of a workspace when opened from home
(Low) Make card actions accessible on touch devices
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace.jsx home onRun: switchGroup(id) then startRun relies on setGroup mutating the api module's currentGroup synchronously - works (verified POST /api/runs?group=<id>), but fragile; pass group explicitly as a param.
HomeScreen's panelProps duplicates SidePanel callbacks already defined for the browser view (onRunSkill/onPreviewSkill/onTemplateOpened) - extract shared object to keep both in sync (DRY).
onRunSkill from home sheet starts the run but stays on home with sheet open; fine, but no visual feedback other than toast.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 1 medium mobile layout bug
